evidenceAuthority: Agent-generated bounded factual observation; it can support repository criteria but cannot grant human authority, attest a later HEAD or create a release.

repositorySurface.referenceProjectionAlignment: shared K/H/L semantics and lifecycle boundary; host-required names, manifests and metadata intentionally differ

currentRepositoryCandidateVerification.scope: The current repository tree is independently recomputed by the canonical verifier; this observation does not bind or attest the later committed SHA or its hosted results.

codexCloudHostedBaseline.limitation: The Cloud checkout had no Git remote or origin/main ref; it proved the supplied exact SHA, while local git ls-remote and GitHub Actions independently established that SHA as origin/main.

ordinaryAdversarialReview.claim: Bounded ordinary review and regression tests; not an exhaustive field-security certification.

R1.claim: The active repository surface contains one K1-K5/H1-H10/L1-L7 semantic contract, one generic data-driven verifier and no active historical outcome-validator generation.

R4.claim: The public release surface, bounded evidence, three-system GitHub route and ordinary Codex Cloud route reproduced on one exact pushed baseline; the final unchanged candidate still requires separate task-time external hosted evidence and human authority.

Q2.claim: The verifier keeps deterministic, representative and continuing lanes distinct, rejects criterion/evidence mismatch and repository release self-authorization, and withholds repositoryCandidateReady from a dirty or unavailable Git checkout despite every green contract command.

Q3.claim: The retained surface is below every declared complexity ceiling, removes O1-O5 proof generations from the active path, keeps both host packages Skill-only and has no default dependency on separately governed user-level Skills.
